data.etymology: Oneida belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “One's people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oneida total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
data.cultural_impact: In ancient Iroquoian culture, the name Oneida was originally used to identify a specific Iroquoian people. Today, it is also recognized as the name of a native American reservation located in upstate New York. The cultural significance of the name extends beyond its historical roots as it is also used by various Christian communities, including the Oneida Community, a communal Christian sect that thrived in the late 1800s.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian contexts, the name Oneida represents unity and belonging to God's community. This was exemplified by the Oneida Community, which was founded on principles of Christian communal living, brotherly love, and unity in faith. Through its name and communal lifestyle, the Oneida Community embodied the spiritual significance of unity and belonging to a larger, divine family. Additionally, the name Oneida may serve as a reminder to all Christians of their connection to the larger spiritual community of believers, symbolizing a sense of oneness and unity that transcends physical boundaries.
